reason: My Instagram is my storefront and my proof, and I'm not putting it behind a Chrome extension that sends DMs for me, even at a human pace. Also, AI-written DMs always sound robotic and prospects can tell, and there are no customer results anywhere to show me otherwise.
objection: If this gets my main account flagged or restricted I lose months of content and clients, and I'd be paying $147 a month, with no results from anyone else, to risk that. 'It never asks for your password' doesn't tell me the account is safe.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from coaches like me, with actual DMs it wrote and the replies they got, plus an honest account of what has happened to people's accounts. I'd also want a way to try it on a throwaway account first, without a card.
